slots.notes: lucide-react line-icon glyphs, one per feature card across the 3-card grid (placeholders Monitor, Palette, Zap). Rendered size 32 / strokeWidth 2.5, sitting top-left of each card and wrapped in a text-white/90 div so they tint via currentColor; not swappable image assets, swap by picking different lucide glyph names.

fontRoles.body: ui-sans-serif (Tailwind font-sans system stack; no custom face declared)

colorRoles.border: linear-gradient (per-card gradient border via padding-box/border-box clip, no flat border color)

mechanic: A 3-up responsive grid of glassy #1A1A1C cards, each ringed by an 8px transparent border filled with a per-card linear gradient via the padding-box/border-box background-clip trick and underlaid by a blurred (45px) opacity-60 copy of that same gradient as a glow, with cards fading and rising in (opacity 0->1, y 30->0, 0.8s easeOut) on a staggered 0.1s-per-card delay.
techDelivery: React 19 + Vite + Tailwind CSS v4, with lucide-react for icons and motion/react (Framer Motion) for the entry animation; authored as a reusable FeatureCard component spec instantiated three times in a grid.
reskinNotes: Brand color lives entirely in three per-card CSS gradients hardcoded in the card data array (Card1 linear-gradient(137deg,#FF3D77 0%,#FFB1CE 45%,#FF9D3C 100%); Card2 linear-gradient(137deg,#FFFFFF 0%,#7DD3FC 45%,#06B6D4 100%); Card3 linear-gradient(137deg,#4361EE 0%,#E0AEFF 45%,#F72585 100%)) and each gradient is consumed twice per card - once as the blurred glow background and once as the border-box layer of the background-clip border - so a single swap must update both inline-style usages. The card surface #1A1A1C is baked literally into both the padding-box gradient string and any flat fill, and the page bg #0A0A0B plus white/gray-400 text are Tailwind arbitrary-value utilities in the markup, not tokens. All card titles (Hardware/Studio/Motion) and descriptions, plus the icon glyph choices and per-card stagger delays, are hardcoded in the component data array. Layout depends on fixed pixel card metrics (max-w 260/300px, h 260/300px, rounded 40px, 8px border, p-7) rather than fluid sizing.
